title: Take my own English name — it...
content_text:
Take my own English name — it comes from Leon: The Professional, and its English title is just Leon too.
So you see, English movie titles tend to be minimal — usually just a person's name — while Chinese titles like to build in connections and character traits.
That's a really interesting pattern.
That reminds me — in the movie, someone says Heidi doesn't sound like a proper Christian name. What's the background there?
